tools.name: search_hts
tools.description: Free search of the official USITC HTS text. Returns candidate codes and descriptions; rates are locked.

tools.name: get_hts_code
tools.description: Paid exact HTS lookup. Returns description, MFN/special/other rates, units, and source. Requires x402 payment.

tools.name: estimate_duty
tools.description: Paid MFN duty estimate for a customs value. Requires x402 payment. Does not include Section 301/AD-CVD.

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Paid landed-cost estimate: MFN duty, legacy Section 301 China, forced-labor 12.5%, Section 232 metals baseline, CBP MPF/HMF, freight, insurance, and other fees. AD/CVD cases are matched but rates are not auto-added. Excludes some exclusions and FTAs. Requires x402 payment.

tools.name: get_trade_actions
tools.description: Paid combined lookup of legacy Section 301 China, forced-labor 12.5%, Section 232 metals, AD/CVD case matches, and IEEPA status. Includes citations. Requires x402 payment.

tools.name: classify_product
tools.description: Paid HTS classification candidates for a product description: ranked 8-digit lines with scores and Section 301/232/forced-labor flags. Candidates only, not a ruling. Requires x402 payment.

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost_batch
tools.description: Paid batch landed-cost estimate for up to 200 rows in one call. Price is 0.005 USDC per row (minimum 0.02). Requires x402 payment.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_hts_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_trade_actions" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
